description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional states observed in a study evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different emotional state: Frustration, Neutral, Happiness, Excitement, Sadness, and Anger. The slices are colored light blue, blue, purple, red, orange, and yellow, respectively. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, indicating the proportion of each emotional state, with Frustration at 25.1%, Neutral at 23.1%, Happiness at 8.1%, Excitement at 14.1%, Sadness at 14.7%, and Anger at 14.9%. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, generally decreasing in size from Frustration to Happiness. A legend is not present, but each slice is directly labeled with its corresponding emotional state.
